flash_694350.description: Bereaved father and Likud candidate responds to the outcry over his comments about released hostage Yocheved Lifshitz: “How low can one go?"

flash_694349.description:
United Torah Judaism chairman MK Yaakov Asher responded to reports that the Gur Hasidic movement is considering abstaining from a vote if Gadi Eisenkot succeeds in forming the next government.

“United Torah Judaism has no desire to bring anyone down or crown anyone, and we do not act out of revenge or any other interests. The only thing guiding us is the directive of the leading rabbis, according to which United Torah Judaism, in all its components, will neither support nor join any government without securing the status of Torah scholars," Asher said.

flash_694347.description:
Iranian news agencies reported an explosion that was heard on Qeshm Island on Monday evening.

Iranian state TV later reported that the blasts were likely warning shots aimed at vessels in violation, and did not provide further details.

flash_694363.description: Arkia, Sun d’Or and Israir are set to launch direct flights to Morocco this fall as Israel-Morocco ties deepen and travel demand rises.

flash_694362.description: Thousands from across Israel take part in the traditional Jerusalem March during Sukkot, concluding with a festive family celebration in Sacher Park.

flash_694361.description: Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam urges implementation of the Israel framework, including an Israeli withdrawal and Hezbollah disarmament, during talks with Rubio.

flash_694359.description: The Finance Ministry opposes ZIM’s request to approve its proposed merger with German shipping giant Hapag-Lloyd and FIMI Opportunity Funds.

flash_694355.description: OpenAI has scrapped plans to release GPT-6.1 Astra after the AI model failed to meet the company’s safety standards amid growing scrutiny of AI security.

flash_694353.description:
Sirens were sounded in Samaria following a suspected terrorist infiltration at Havat Maginzi.

Residents were instructed to enter their safe rooms, securely lock the doors, and remain below window level. Residents are instructed not to leave the safe room until receiving an official notification from the authorities.

flash_694351.description: Iranian parliament member Hamid Rezaei has been sentenced to 10 months in the notorious Evin Prison after being convicted of “publishing false statements" against Parliament Speaker Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf.

flash_694348.description: President Trump rejects an Axios report that he offered Iran sanctions relief and frozen funds, insisting, “I offered them NOTHING!"

flash_694346.description: Trump says the Iran war will end “very soon" with a US victory, warning of the global consequences of a nuclear-armed Iran: Israel would be wiped out, there would be no Middle East

flash_694386.description: An aircraft used by Saddam Haftar reportedly landed in Abu Dhabi shortly after Netanyahu, prompting an unconfirmed claim that the two met.

flash_694385.description: The mitzvah of Torah study is equal to all the other mitzvot. The reward for the mitzvah of Torah study is equal to the reward of all the mitzvot. Every person of Israel who engages in Torah sustains the world.

flash_694383.description:
El Al flight LY017 from Tel Aviv to Miami turned back toward Tel Aviv several hours after takeoff due to an unexpected technical malfunction.

Read more.

flash_694381.description: The Attorney General and State Attorney have declared support for the petition to disqualify Sami Abu Shahhdah from the Knesset for supporting a fight against Israel.

flash_694379.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned on Tuesday morning the violent riots that took place overnight in the Binyamin region and the attacks on security forces who arrived at the scene.

"The handful of rioters does not represent the law-abiding settler population in Judea and Samaria; it does a tremendous injustice and interferes with our forces in carrying out their mission," Netanyahu said.

Netanyahu expressed his support for the IDF soldiers and Border Police officers operating in the area and called on law enforcement authorities to take action against those involved.

"I fully support the IDF soldiers and Border Police officers who are working to thwart terrorism and maintain security, and I call on law enforcement authorities to prosecute the rioters to the fullest extent of the law," he stated.

flash_694378.description: Regulated fuel prices will rise during the night between Wednesday and Thursday by 52 agorot per liter for 95-octane gasoline.

flash_694376.description: An extract from “Bechayil U’v Ruach," the last book that Rav Chaim Druckman approved for publication before he passed away, less than a year before the start of the war in Gaza.

flash_694374.description: Police officers from the Um al-Fahm station used a police dog to locate a weapon buried deep in the ground.

flash_694372.description:
President Isaac Herzog condemned the violence in the village of Jalud, calling it "an extremely serious incident that must be dealt with to the fullest extent of the law. It is a moral stain and an affront to the rule of law."

"Arson, rock-throwing, and the assault and injury of IDF soldiers and Border Police officers are absolutely prohibited and can have no justification whatsoever," he said.

Herzog called on the authorities "to act decisively against the lawbreakers and bring them to justice."

flash_694371.description:
Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar condemned the overnight riots in the area of the village of Jalud in Samaria, which included the torching of property and injuries to Border Police officers. Sa'ar stated that an investigation had been launched and called for it to be conducted thoroughly and comprehensively to bring the rioters to justice.

"Those who commit these criminal offenses, divert the attention of Border Police and IDF soldiers, and even harm them, are criminals who must be dealt with to the fullest extent of the law," Sa'ar said. According to him, the rioters "harm our values, Jewish settlement, and Israel."

flash_694370.description: Hezbollah Is weakened but still controls the narrative.

flash_694369.description: War has always produced critics. But there is a difference between criticizing a war-and asking someone else to carry its consequences while you collect the applause. Op-ed.

flash_694368.description: Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz dismisses the polls, urges voters not to fear the electoral threshold, and says Israel’s future depends on breaking the political blocs.

flash_694367.description:
Netanyahu and Katz confirm the elimination of Hamas Northern Gaza Brigade commander Izz al-Din al-Baik in a targeted airstrike in western Gaza City.

Read more.

flash_694366.description: Ben-Gvir reiterates his demand to become Defense Minister, vowing to burn the bodies of Sinwar and October 7 terrorists currently held in Israel.

flash_694365.description: The Palestinian Arabs are reporting that vehicles were set on fire overnight in the village of al-Mughayyir in Binyamin, and claim that Jews were responsible.

flash_694364.description: Israeli rioters block roads, set fires, and attack security forces near Jalud, preventing the coordinated return of a Palestinian family to its home.

flash_694360.description:
Police arrested five suspects during a celebration in Jerusalem on suspicion of disorderly conduct and violence against civilians and police officers.

Among other incidents, a gathering on Haim Bar-Lev and Sachs streets blocked the light rail tracks while trains were being moved. Police used crowd-dispersal measures to restore order at the scene.

flash_694358.description: Israel summons Spain’s chargé d’affaires over minister’s “river to the sea" remarks as tensions between Jerusalem and Madrid continue to escalate.

flash_694404.description: Ohr Torah Stone President Rabbi Dr. Kenneth Brander condemns the attack on Jalud, calling for those responsible to be investigated and held accountable.

flash_694403.description: Mediapart published conversations from 2013 in which antisemitic statements are attributed to the president of the right-wing party. Bardella denies the allegations and has filed a defamation lawsuit.

flash_694402.description: A man who spent 41 years on death row in the US after being convicted of killing a woman has been released on bail after prosecutors said a new analysis of DNA evidence did not link him to the crime.

flash_694401.description: King Mohammed VI has appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as Morocco’s prime minister after her party won the largest number of seats in the parliamentary elections.

flash_694400.description: Prime Minister files NIS 2.6 million defamation lawsuit against media outlets and journalists over reports that he received warnings before October 7.

flash_694399.description: Ireland can keep the three points, it must also own the ugliness it brought into the “Beautiful Game."

flash_694398.description: A TVP Info crew covering a fatal accident in Poland captured another crash as a car hit a 14-year-old girl on a scooter. The reporter and cameraman rushed to help.

flash_694397.description: Melbourne Islamic preacher calls in a sermon to reject Jews and Christians as friends and take up arms against them, amid criticism over Australia's response to extremist incitement.

flash_694396.description: Antisemitism is so hip, so cool. Don’t these people know that they have moved to the side of the devil? Opinion.

flash_694395.description: A construction worker lost consciousness in a crane cab in Kiryat Bialik. An MDA paramedic climbed 55 meters to treat him and he was evacuated to Rambam in stable condition.

flash_694394.description: Netanyahu said there are indications that Israel’s enemies will attempt to attack ahead of the elections. Lapid demanded an urgent briefing, and Netanyahu instructed his military secretary to update him.

flash_694393.description: The Finance Minister instructed professional officials to prepare for additional subsidies on gasoline prices, in an effort to mitigate the expected increase amid the global energy crisis.

flash_694392.description: After their request was rejected by the Central Elections Committee, the Democrats party petitioned the Supreme Court, demanding that Otzma Yehudit be disqualified from running for the Knesset.

flash_694391.description: Minister Katz responded to the elimination of the commander of Hamas' Northern Gaza Brigade and made clear that the defense establishment will continue pursuing the terrorist organization's senior leaders.

flash_694390.description: Ahead of the anniversary of October 7, KKL-JNF clarified that visits to the Nova site in the Re’im Forest will be permitted solely for remembrance and commemoration.

flash_694389.description: Israeli defense company UVision is partnering with Estonia’s LendurAI to integrate advanced AI and autonomous capabilities into its loitering munitions for an undisclosed NATO member state.

flash_694388.description: Britain has suspended or refused more than 80 export licences for items potentially used by the IDF in Gaza, the Jewish Chronicle reports.

flash_694387.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said today at the Tel Nof Air Force Base that there are signs Israel’s enemies may attempt to attack the country ahead of the elections.

Netanyahu issued a warning to Israel’s enemies, saying: "Don’t mess with us. Our long arm will reach you anywhere, at any time."

flash_694384.description: Dr. Dan Diker urges Israel to use economic pressure against the Palestinian Authority and launch a more aggressive international campaign to counter boycotts of Israeli products.

flash_694382.description: Protesters gathered across Morocco after Rabat and Jerusalem agreed to open embassies and exchange ambassadors, with police detaining several in Tangier.

flash_694380.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz condemned the riots while visiting Judea and Samaria alongside the head of the IDF Central Command, saying that those involved "divert forces from their missions and seriously undermine security efforts, the settlement enterprise, and the State of Israel." Katz emphasized that the rioters do not represent the settler population and called for decisive action against them and for those responsible to be brought to justice.

flash_694377.description: Approximately 10,000 worshipers, led by Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu, prayed, sang, and danced at the Cave of the Patriarchs in Hebron.

flash_694375.description: No members of Andy Burnham’s cabinet are expected at the Labour Friends of Israel reception, days after Ed Miliband addressed a Palestinian event.

flash_694418.description:
The Likud party criticized opposition leader Yair Lapid after the Prime Minister’s Office issued a statement following his meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The party claimed that Lapid issued a political statement attacking Netanyahu just minutes after the meeting ended.

“He left the meeting with Prime Minister Netanyahu at 11:39 p.m. At 11:41 p.m., just two minutes later, at record speed, he issued a lengthy statement that was entirely a political attack on the Prime Minister," Likud said. “Either he writes at the speed of light, or the statement was prepared in advance and had nothing to do with the briefing he received. So much for the late-night Lapid."

flash_694417.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu concluded a security briefing with opposition leader Yair Lapid, attended by the Prime Minister’s military secretary and the Military Secretariat’s intelligence officer.

The Prime Minister’s Office said the intelligence briefing included detailed warnings of possible attacks on various fronts ahead of the elections.

flash_694416.description:
Police launched an investigation into suspected arson in an open area near the community of Kokhav Yaakov. IDF soldiers from the Binyamin Brigade who were called to the scene arrested a suspect in connection with the incident.

The suspect, a 13-year-old resident of Qalandiya, was taken for questioning at the Binyamin police station. The investigation is ongoing.

flash_694415.description: The blessing of being Jewish in this world is to live every stage of life with dignity, meaning, and purpose. Op-ed.

flash_694414.description:
Opposition leader Yair Lapid commented on the security briefing he received from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying he would not violate the confidentiality of the briefing, but argued that “Israel’s security and IDF bases are not the backdrop for campaign videos."

According to Lapid, the IDF, Shin Bet and police are prepared for the elections and “there is no reason to cause public panic." He added that he demanded Netanyahu hold a meeting with the Shin Bet chief and Central Elections Committee Chairman Justice Noam Solberg ahead of the election.

flash_694413.description: The strength required to build our home, that is, our national homeland, must be spiritual might, the might of the festival, the might of God’s eternal word.

flash_694412.description: President Trump says Iran is struggling and will eventually “give up," while insisting Tehran cannot be allowed to obtain a nuclear weapon.

flash_694411.description: Nearly a week after Neria Leiter was critically wounded in a terror attack on Route 443, his mother, Hani, speaks about the uncertainty in the ICU, hopes for his recovery, and the family that has remained by his side around the clock.

flash_694410.description: Anti-Defamation League criticizes New York City mayor's newly unveiled strategy to combat antisemitism, citing lack of formal definition and accusing him of prioritizing his 'anti-Israel agenda.'

flash_694406.description: Larissa Amir Trimbobler attacked National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir after Yigal Amir’s request for special leave due to his 85-year-old father’s condition was denied on security issues.

flash_694405.description: For years, Mohammed Dahlan was one of Hamas’s fiercest enemies and a senior figure in the Palestinian security services that fought the organization. Now, a dramatic rapprochement causes worry on the battle over who will succeed Mahmoud Abbas.

flash_694424.description: Qatar’s efforts to bridge differences between the US and Iran have stalled, with both sides holding firm as concerns grow over renewed military conflict, according to Axios.

flash_694423.description: Moving: IDF soldier Yotam Asban, critically wounded fighting in Jabaliya, joins Simchat Beit Hashoeva celebration at Mercaz HaRav and dances with Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich.

flash_694422.description: A US State Department spokesperson commented on the violence against Palestinian Arabs in Judea and Samaria overnight in an interview with i24NEWS, saying: “We condemn criminal violence by any party in the West Bank and support appropriate investigations, prosecutions, and legal action against those responsible."

flash_694420.description: Palestinian Arab media outlets reported that Israeli airstrikes were carried out east of Gaza City.

flash_694447.description: The Israel Defense Forces (Wednesday) published this morning footage from body cameras of Golani Brigade soldiers, as they complete seven months of operations in southern Lebanon.

flash_694446.description: A passenger who was aboard the flight told i24NEWS that during the unusual incident, an attempt was made to stab the pilot. "The entire cockpit was covered in blood. The Israeli guys took control of the situation and caught the attacker," the passenger said.

flash_694445.description: Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv lands in Saudi Arabia; distress signaled apparently sent due to violent clash between pilots.

flash_694443.description: Israel has reopened its airspace after the devoted jet was reported to have landed safely in Saudi Arabia.

flash_694441.description: Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv contacts Saudi authorities; Israel estimates diversion not security-related.

flash_694439.description: Police Commissioner Daniel Levi said that the Israel Police are prepared for any eventuality in the case of the suspected hijacking. Israeli forces nevertheless estimate that the plan was not actually hijacked.

flash_694437.description:
An unusual incident occurred on a flight from Abu Dhabi to Tel Aviv when a Flydubai pilot entered a hijacking code, signaling that the aircraft had been hijacked.

Following the incident, the aircraft was diverted to Saudi Arabia.

Read more

flash_694435.description: Source involved in Qatar-mediated talks says Washington and Tehran are hardening positions.

flash_694433.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu reportedly shares fresh Israeli intelligence on Iran's renewed nuclear advances during secret Abu Dhabi talks.

flash_694431.description: Syrian intelligence thwart a planned rocket attack in Daraa, arresting three Hezbollah-linked suspects and seizing weapon shipments.

flash_694429.description: Shin Bet Director David Zini approves measures including active threat monitoring, coordination with private security teams, and armed protection even without a specific threat.

flash_694427.description: Saudi Arabia rejects reports that its representatives attended a meeting between PM Netanyahu and UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed in Abu Dhabi.

flash_694425.description: Senate Republicans defeat a Democratic resolution seeking a State Department report on Israeli actions and violence in Judea and Samaria.

flash_694421.description: Trump praises major tech executives for a new AI safety commitment, arguing self-policing can address risks without slowing development or adding regulations.

flash_694419.description: Nearly 100 draft evaders participate in a Jerusalem march following their release from military prison, with some carrying signs denouncing the IDF.

flash_694495.description: Ordeal over: Flydubai flight with Israeli passengers lands in Ben-Gurion Airport

flash_694494.description: Ignorance and denial of reality are prerequisites to working at the UN, to which truth and human rights for Jews are unknown concepts. Opinion.

flash_694491.description:
MDA teams are on standby at the airport to meet the passengers arriving from Saudi Arabia.

Magen David Adom teams, together with the medical clinic teams at Ben Gurion Airport, are on standby at the airport with mobile intensive care units (MICUs) and ambulances to meet the passengers arriving in Israel from Saudi Arabia.

MDA paramedics will conduct medical assessments of the passengers and, if necessary, provide medical care

flash_694490.description:
President Isaac Herzog visited the Judea and Samaria Division on Wednesday and addressed the attempted terrorist attack aboard the Flydubai flight.

“We went through several very tense hours during a very serious incident that, fortunately, ended with a great miracle and acts of heroism. We embrace and support our brothers and sisters who are on their way back to Israel and thank the heroes. Of course, we will act in every way to thoroughly investigate the incident together with our Emirati partners," Herzog said.

flash_694489.description: The pilot of flydubai flight FZ 1073, who helped prevent its hijacking by his co-pilot and was stabbed, is Dubai-based Indian Captain Smit Machchhar.

flash_694488.description: BBC presenter calls Israel's main international airport by name of National Security Minister instead of Ben Gurion.

flash_694486.description: Netanyahu expected to meet Flydubai passengers upon arrival in TLV

flash_694484.description: Tzvika Manes, one of the passengers who subdued the pilot, recounts the critical moments: screams from the cockpit, a terrifying dive and a violent struggle.

flash_694482.description: After initial refusal and Mossad approval: All Israeli passengers board plane back to Israel

flash_694480.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz confirmed on Wednesday afternoon that the incident aboard the Flydubai flight was an attempted terrorist attack.

“The serious incident on the Flydubai aircraft was an attempted jihadist terrorist attack that was thwarted only thanks to the bravery of several Israeli passengers who broke into the cockpit, overpowered the terrorist, and, with their own hands, restored control of the aircraft to an additional flight crew that was present there. According to the preliminary information in our possession, the terrorist had one intention: to crash the plane with all its passengers.

“When the Prime Minister and I issue security warnings and alerts based on intelligence, everyone - both our enemies abroad and uninformed former officials at home - would do well to listen and take them seriously. Every warning has several addresses and objectives. Most importantly, the warnings never come at the expense of the proactive and offensive operations that we are leading together with the IDF against every threat, nor are they a substitute for them," Katz said.

flash_694479.description: Prime Minister says pilot who stabbed fellow pilot apparently attempted to crash plane: 'The passengers who neutralized him saved many lives and prevented a major disaster.'

flash_694478.description: Zara pulled a children’s Halloween costume after its striped design sparked comparisons to Nazi concentration camp uniforms.

flash_694477.description:
Mike Huckabee said Wednesday that Israeli passengers helped subdue a co-pilot who apparently attempted to take control of a plane.

“Details still unclear but Israelis on board helped subdue the copilot who apparently tried to take over the plane," Huckabee wrote on X. “Could have been a horrific incident but everyone safe."

flash_694476.description: Boarding of the replacement flight has begun and landing was scheduled for 6:00 p.m., but several Israelis are refusing to fly with Flydubai again.

flash_694475.description: Israeli officials await results of Saudi interrogation of Omani co-pilot suspected of stabbing pilot and attempting to crash Israel-bound Flydubai plane. Mossad chief coordinating investigation.

flash_694474.description: Rescue crews were called to Jerusalem’s Gilo neighborhood, where a female driver had driven off a five-meter-high drop and crashed into a private garden. She was rescued from the vehicle conscious in light to moderate condition.

flash_694473.description:
The belief is growing that the co-pilot planned to crash the plane in order to kill the 150 Israeli passengers on board.

An initial investigation into the incident suggests that the Emirati pilot, who acted to prevent him from carrying out the plan with the help of some of the Israeli passengers, used an emergency axe that was in the cockpit during the takeover.

It is believed that during the struggle, the pilot stabbed the co-pilot with the axe, which is designed to break the cockpit window in emergencies. The exact circumstances of the incident are still under investigation.

flash_694472.description: Lapid said that during his briefing with Netanyahu, no incident resembling what occurred on the flight was mentioned. Political official: He was briefed on a significant increase in terrorist activity abroad.

flash_694471.description: Rabbi Dov Lando sharply condemns haredi voices urging election boycott, saying those promoting such a move act out of 'wickedness or stupidity.'

flash_694470.description: Another Flydubai flight to evacuate passengers from Saudi Arabia; El Al, IDF offers rejected

flash_694469.description: After three days of efforts, a group of Israelis stranded in Lalibela due to the security escalation was evacuated by helicopter.

flash_694468.description: Report in Iran: Explosion heard in the city of Zahedan

flash_694467.description: Passengers aboard a Flydubai flight diverted to Saudi Arabia on Wednesday say they heard shouts of 'Allahu Akbar' during the incident.

flash_694466.description: Foreign Ministry: Group of Israelis stranded in northern Ethiopia evacuated safely

flash_694513.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu published a statement saluting Captain Smit Machchhar, the Flydubai pilot who fought off his terrorist co-pilot and was stabbed in the process.

"My salute to the Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar for his extraordinary bravery. Despite being stabbed and seriously injured, he fought back, resisted, opened the cockpit door, and enabled passengers and crew to overpower the attacker - preventing a catastrophic mid-air disaster."

"He saved the lives of 174 people, including Israeli citizens and other nationals. I wish Captain Machchhar a speedy and full recovery. He is a true hero," Netanyahu wrote.

flash_694512.description: Airline suspends flights for six days after co-pilot attempts to crash plane full of Israelis.

flash_694511.description:
Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana published a message praising and calling for prayers for the Indian Flydubai pilot who was stabbed by his co-pilot, who attempted to hijack and crash the plane.

"The people of Israel are praying for Captain Smit Machchhar, the brave Indian pilot who fought off his co-pilot’s mid-air attack to save the Israeli passengers aboard flydubai flight FZ1073.

"In a moment of terror, he showed extraordinary courage. Today, our hearts are with him and his family."

flash_694510.description: i24NEWS Arab affairs analyst and former airline security guard says attempted hijacking required sophisticated planning, raises possibility Iran or its proxies were behind the incident.

flash_694509.description:
Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar spoke on Wednesday with the Foreign Minister of the United Arab Emirates, Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan.

During the conversation, which Sa'ar described as "warm," the two expressed their mutual determination to strengthen relations between the countries at all levels and to work together against extremist elements seeking to harm security and undermine stability in the region.

He updated his counterpart on the return of the Israeli passengers. The Emirati Foreign Minister said he was happy to hear that all the Israeli passengers had returned home safely.

flash_694508.description: At the IDF’s Judea and Samaria Division headquarters, Herzog condemned recent violence, backed troops fighting terror, and called for arrests.

flash_694507.description:
The Indian pilot who was stabbed during the incident aboard the Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv is no longer in life-threatening condition, although he remains seriously wounded.

The pilot, who was injured during the confrontation with the copilot, managed to open the cockpit door before collapsing, allowing passengers and crew members to intervene and take control of the situation. The plane later landed safely in Saudi Arabia.

flash_694506.description:
Israeli Minister of Culture and Sports Miki Zohar thanked the Saudis on Wednesday after a plane with nearly 150 Israelis was diverted to the country due to an attempted hijacking.

"On behalf of the people of Israel, I thank the Saudi people for the warm welcome and kindness they showed the Israeli passengers rescued this morning."

"G-d willing, may peace come to us and to all the people of Israel."

He included a video showing a Saudi nurse caring for one of the Israeli passengers in the airport.

flash_694505.description:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee remarked on the attempted hijacking of a Flydubai flight from the UAE to Israel and praised the Israelis who subdued the terrorist.

"We thank G-d and breathe a deep sigh of relief that the passengers of Fly Dubai FZ1073 are now safely in Israel. Their heroism in the face of terror averted catastrophe," Huckabee wrote on social media.

"Israel endures because its people refuse to surrender. And tonight we are even more proud to call this extraordinary nation our true partner," he added.

flash_694504.description: A diplomatic source said of the attempted terrorist attack on the flight from Dubai: “The terrorist wanted to undermine the Abraham Accords."

flash_694503.description: At Ben Gurion Airport, Netanyahu embraced Yaniv, one of the Israeli passengers who subdued the rogue copilot and said he pulled the diving Flydubai plane back up.

flash_694502.description: Captain Smit Machchhar, from India, joined flydubai four years ago and fought the terrorist for his life and the lives of the passengers in the cockpit.

flash_694501.description: Israeli Consulate in New York launches campaign displaying the faces of those murdered in the October 7 massacre. Consul General Ofir Akunis: We will not forget, and we will not forgive.

flash_694498.description: 'Thank you for bringing our people home': Rescue flight from Saudi Arabia lands in Israel

flash_694497.description:
Sorry, that tweet doesn't exist!
After preventing their plane from being hijacked earlier in the day and spending hours in Saudi Arabia, Israeli passengers sing as the Flydubai rescue flight lands in Israel.

flash_694496.description: Elyakim Itali's son and two grandchildren were aboard the Flydubai flight. Speaking from Ben Gurion Airport, he recounts the hours of anxiety and what his family told him about the incident.

flash_694487.description: The Palestinian Arabs are unique pioneers in plane hijackings. Op-ed.

flash_694485.description: Flydubai replacement flight has taken off from Saudi Arabia with 174 Israelis, after the passengers who initially refused to board have been convinced to join their fellow passengers.

flash_694522.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham says there are “strong indications" Iran was involved a terror plot near RAF Fairford which led to the arrests of five men.

flash_694521.description:
Magen David Adom reported that 24 people were evacuated to hospitals following the fire at the nursing home in Bnei Brak.

Two men, aged 65 and around 80, were taken to Sheba Hospital in serious condition with second-degree burns. A 75-year-old woman was transported in moderate condition, while another person was taken in mild condition with signs of smoke inhalation.

Two men, aged around 80 and 50, were taken to Beilinson Hospital in moderate condition, along with three others in mild condition with signs of smoke inhalation. A 73-year-old woman was taken to Ichilov Hospital in moderate condition, along with three others in mild condition with signs of smoke inhalation.

Nine people in mild condition with signs of smoke inhalation were taken to Maayanei Hayeshua Hospital. Two additional people in mild condition were evacuated from the scene.

flash_694520.description: Speaking to CNN, Netanyahu says the crew and passengers’ actions prevented “a 9/11 disaster" on the Flydubai flight: “We’ll know soon if Iran is involved."

flash_694519.description:
A fire broke out at a nursing home in Bnei Brak, in an apartment on the first floor of the eight-story building, a Fire and Rescue Services spokesperson said.

Two people were seriously injured. Around 20 additional residents were treated at the scene, with their conditions described as light.

flash_694517.description: As part of IDF operations in the Gaza Strip, explosions have been heard and are expected to be heard in the central Gaza border area, particularly near the Sdot Negev and Shaar HaNegev Regional Councils and the city of Sderot.

flash_694515.description: An Israeli citizen was murdered on Wednesday on Koh Phangan island in Thailand. His identity and the circumstances surrounding the murder have not yet been released.
